decisions.reason: The clarified bushing fit and rod guidance do not change the existing shaft material, fabrication sequence, or requirement to machine the 82 mm inner diameter after welding.
The source does not change the M72x1.5 locking thread, its width, or the 65 mm main-bushing space.
The bushing placement, clearance fit, and piston-rod guidance do not alter the requirement to omit the keyway at cross section C-C.
The mechanical arrangement clarification does not change assembly-aligned drawing numbering.
The source changes the bushing arrangement and fit but does not change CuSn12 for the bushing or S355 JRG2 for other parts.
The source establishes target-specific bushing geometry and fit under the source Requirement; it does not modify the candidate's general drawing-dimension content or presentation state.
The mechanical clarification does not change the required IPT or STEP deliverable formats.
The bushing and piston-rod clarification does not change the requirement to comply with the usual ČSN/EN drawing standards.
